fusions.name: Broken Reef Hurl
fusions.desc: Rips up a coral head and hurls it for 26 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It bursts over every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the damage.

fusions.name: Shard Scatter
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws a fistful of 4 coral shards in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 5 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooted Outcrop
fusions.desc: Plants a coral outcrop that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Calcified Skin
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
